narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Divide by one hundred and twenty six, and the car goes about one point eight six kilometres.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Two hundred and forty shared by twelve is twenty, so the answer is near twenty.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The distance had to be multiplied by ten as well.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Multiply both numbers by ten or a hundred so the divisor is a counting number.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>When the answer does not end, round it to a sensible number of places.

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip divides by one hundred and twenty six without changing the distance, and gets about one point eight six kilometres. That is ten times too small.
